title: ynh trust show --image --format json
description: Output of `ynh trust show --image <ref> --format json`: the trust labels of a harness image already on this host, read with `docker image inspect`. Nothing is pulled and no container starts. The labels are the build host's acceptance, which the image's own gate never reads; the running host can verify them, never must. With --full, `trust` is the image's own `ynh trust show local/<name> --format json` (see trust-show.schema.json), run in a container with no network and no mounts, listing what the image executes, each baked a2a delegate's record and level included. A label the image does not carry (an image built before it existed) is null. Not enveloped. It changes nothing.

Label.description: The label's value, or null when the image does not carry it.

harness.description: dev.ynh.harness: the harness the image carries.

trust_digest.description: dev.ynh.harness.trust-digest: the digest of what the image executes, as the build host accepted it.

trust_via.description: dev.ynh.harness.trust-via: how the build host accepted it.

source.description: dev.ynh.harness.source: where the harness came from.

trust.description: Present with --full: the image's own trust show block.
